title: It's Official: GTA 6 Made $3.79 Billion in One Day 💰 #Shorts
description:
Take-Two made it official: GTA 6 hit $3.79 billion in day-one retail sales (company estimate, worldwide, through November 19), which it calls a new record for entertainment across any medium and the biggest entertainment launch in history. The game also sold 32.5 million units before release, another record. For comparison, GTA 5 made about $815 million on its first day in 2013. The earlier third-party estimate was $2.36 billion (Sensor Tower).

Did you buy it on day one? Comment below!

Sources: Take-Two Interactive press release (Nov 20, 2026, SEC Form 8-K exhibit 99.1); TweakTown, PC Gamer, CNN, Forbes.
